events.summary: Universal C=pi fails; every candidate C must be >=3sqrt(2). Direct cross-block Fourier estimate gives density<=24 for rank-exactly-three frames of maximum row leverage<=1/12. Full arbitrary-matrix conjecture remains not proved.

Probability normalization plus the generic 3D X-ray cap sup_line int_line g<=2 does not by itself bound the minority-sign two-sheet quadratic trace; an explicit thin hyperboloid shell has bounded X-ray norm and q-density of order 1/delta. This is not a QFORM counterexample because product-projection provenance is not imposed.

Conditioning on a conjugate sum/difference variable does not preserve the marginal density cap: for iid Uniform[0,1], ||p_{U|V=v}||_infinity=1/[2(1-|v|)]. The corrected bilinear route incurs unbounded Renyi-spread factors; retain original-coordinate Plancherel or coupled-pair aggregation.

The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not even qualitatively force one nonzero physical scalar pivot whose Schur complement has a rank-two disjoint cross block. The exact account01/B19 target family with spectrum {1,1,-1} leaves only a rank-one 0-Y star after every possible nonzero pivot, yet is uniformly controlled by high-cardinality hyperbolic-square aggregation.

For f_R(x)=1_[1,R]/(x log R), direct absolute-value squaring/ambiguity followed by coordinatewise Hausdorff-Young/Holder has a logarithmically growing majorant even for the diagonal three-square form. Full QFORM is not refuted; retain displacement cancellation or stronger product structure.

Bounded pair density plus bounded conditional hyperbolic-variable density does not replace genuine independence: an exact unit-density three-variable construction has 2SY+Z^2=2YU and a logarithmically unbounded density. The remaining heavy-isotropic proof must retain original product-linear provenance.

Even for A=I_3, separated shell fibers have two bands whose gap can be arbitrarily large while their total length is <1. A finite-fragment unit set captures both bands and twice the small-ball mass available to any unit set with a prescribed finite diameter. Single-interval/centered-uniform localization therefore fails inside the exact target; keep arbitrary fragment separation.

The exact rank-three family A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m) has eigenvalues {1,1,-1}; every coordinate cut has cross rank at most two, while every nonsingular physical principal 3x3 block has sigma_min=1/m and every 4x4 principal block is singular. Hence no universal dichotomy of uniformly good principal 3/4 block OR rank-three original-coordinate cross cut follows from the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis. The target itself is not refuted: bank aggregation gives a uniform density bound, and the structural replacement must aggregate independent coordinate banks before reciprocal minor payment.

An explicit independent cap-one product source with an exact rank-three Parseval projection has positive-measure complement fibers whose normalized indefinite quadratic trace diverges logarithmically, although the full product-law output is uniformly bounded by the completed account03/B16 diffuse-residual theorem. Product aggregation must occur before or jointly with the curved trace.

The absolute phase-Wiener obligation cannot hold universally: for A=I_3 and iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], the spectral transform is a product of sinc functions with infinite L1 norm, so W(t)=infinity for every t although the quadratic output has a bounded continuous density. The sufficient implication remains valid; a universal proof must retain Fresnel/time cancellation before the spectral absolute value.

For every finite M, already for A=I_3 there are fixed second/third marginals with at most M interval components and a target interval such that the exact one-coordinate bathtub optimum for the first marginal requires more than M separated support components. Hence the completed coordinatewise extreme-product localization cannot be strengthened to a universal fixed fragment-count cap while preserving each fixed-fiber optimum. This does not refute the global QFORM conjecture or globally rule out an M-fragment extremality theorem by a different non-coordinatewise mechanism.

The three-large-eigenvalue condition does not force one physical triple whose entire rank-two cross bank has uniformly bounded reciprocal aggregate determinant cost. For A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m), whose nonzero spectrum is {1,1,-1}, taking the singleton plus one coordinate from each bank gives transverse curvature a=1 but Delta_2=sqrt(pdet(MM^T))=(m-1)/m^2, so Delta_2^(-1/2)=m/sqrt(m-1) diverges like sqrt(m). This is not a counterexample to QFORM: the completed account03/B01 diffuse-rank-two plus dependence-safe-square theorem controls the same family uniformly by <7.692.

In the exact-rank-three Sylvester-Hadamard family A=R diag(1,1,-1) R^T, every physical pair with positive same-sign Pluecker determinant weight has full 2x2 physical determinant zero. Hence directly averaging the two-pivot endpoint certificate against same-sign Pluecker mass fails maximally. The repair is to aggregate the original product law on the same-sign spectral plane first; QFORM-WEIGHTED-AFFINE-FIBER-BL-v1 supplies a dimension-free affine-fiber density cap.

A nonzero physical square plus one heavy off-diagonal coefficient does not by itself absorb arbitrary quadratic curvature on that same coefficient-side bank. For independent cap-one U,X uniform on [-1/2,1/2], U^2+X^2+2UX=(U+X)^2 has density t^(-1/2)-1 on 0<t<1 and is unbounded. This is not a full-QFORM counterexample because the matrix has spectrum {2,0}; heavy-bank routing must retain a genuinely independent third smoother or grouped hyperbolic/ridge structure.

Exact zero Schur diagonal admits a product-preserving affine half-Riesz bound, but replacing S_ii=0 by merely |S_ii| small while retaining only the cross-row norm is false. The rank-one family [[epsilon,1],[1,epsilon^-1]] with independent centered unit uniforms has cross-row norm one yet E|X^T S X|^-1/2=infinity. This refutes only the near-zero half-Riesz interface, not QFORM.

The three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis does not force the rank-two hub/star singleton third-volume aggregate G_* to a universal positive scale. A diffuse Walsh two-frame family has nonzero spectrum {-1,-1,1,1} but both side singleton aggregates vanish identically, while every physical cross coefficient is O(1/N) and every cross-bank 2x2 principal determinant is O(1/N^2). The same family is uniformly paid by grouped Pluecker smoothing. The replacement mechanism is a two-sided aggregate collapse to an original-coordinate diagonal plus rank-at-most-four carrier, with an explicit retained residual in the quantitative case.

The auto26 claim ||p_(gamma Z^2+2rZ)||_(3/2)<=min(2|gamma|^(-1/3),(2|r|)^(-1/3)) is false for gamma!=0. Taking Z=-r/gamma+Uniform[-1/2,1/2] makes the output a translated gamma U^2 and attains 2|gamma|^(-1/3) independently of r. Sharp repair: for 1<q<2 the translation-uniform bound is [2^(q-1)/(2-q)]^(1/q)|gamma|^(-1+1/q). The exact gamma=0 external-coupling endpoint remains valid, including ||p_Q||_infinity<=4/sqrt(|bc|) at p=2 and p_Q in C_0. This is not a full-QFORM counterexample.

A nonzero indefinite two-hub core plus robust original-product slope innovation does not absorb an arbitrary completed same-bank remainder. For independent cap-one X,Y,C uniform on [-1/2,1/2], Q=X^2-epsilon Y^2+2CY-C^2/epsilon=X^2-epsilon(Y-C/epsilon)^2 has an unbounded logarithmic density for every 0<epsilon<=1, while its slope innovation is exactly one. The 3x3 matrix has spectrum {1,-(epsilon+epsilon^-1),0}, so this is not a QFORM counterexample; it proves the genuine third curvature must be retained on the indefinite near-null branch.

The account03/B16 r36 suggestion that two physical hubs chosen away from a near-coloop h can avoid the small factor 1-||r_h||^2 by placing h inside the opposite bank J is false as a uniform disjoint grouped-crossing mechanism. The exact grouped Pluecker/Schur factorization gives S_B^2 Z_ell=(det Lambda)^2 V_{k,ell}(H,I)V_3(J), and one of the two disjoint three-basis masses always avoids h; its total available mass is epsilon=1-||r_h||^2. Thus V_{k,ell}(H,I)V_3(J)<=epsilon. A seven-row Parseval frame attains order epsilon with all projected-crossing row marginals equal to 1/2. This is not a QFORM counterexample; the replacement target is overlap-aware punctured-hub stability.

The r42 proposed universal mixed-norm closure integral |t|^(-1/2)||G_t||_2 dt is false even in its normalized small-pivot hard collar and for a strict target A_epsilon with spectrum {-sqrt(1+epsilon^2),1,+sqrt(1+epsilon^2)}. For iid unit uniforms, the exact fiber has ||G_t||_2=|int_{-1/2}^{1/2}e^{it y^2}dy| >= (sqrt(pi)/2)t^(-1/2) for t>=64/pi, so the proposed integral diverges logarithmically. This does not refute QFORM: the same output is bounded by <=128 using the completed rank-two half-Riesz theorem before fiber absoluteization plus the independent third square. The replacement must retain hub-star and a Schur direction jointly before absolute values, or use an already-paid source-separated third-resource exit.
